title: US median high-tide flooding days per year
notes: NOAA's 2024-2025 Annual High Tide Flooding Outlook reports a national median of about 7 more high-tide flooding days per year than in 2000 (a 250%+ increase), and projects 45-85 days/year nationally by 2050 on the current sea-level-rise trend. The 2050 figure is a NOAA projection, not an observed value.
